checks: Additive validation migration leaves existing projects, approvals, histories and Drive jobs byte-identical
Structured assumptions persist through actual repository load, save, reload and a new Auth session
Direct RPC rejects invalid dates and noninteger, negative, excessive or textual durations even in inactive scenarios
Null/empty missing dates and months remain missing; zero must persist explicitly and leap days remain civil dates
Changing personal strategy conserves inactive values while calendar results use only the chosen scenario
Agency reimport persists factual corrections without replacing personal calendar, budgets, comments or legacy timing
A saved calendar change requires both designated approvals to be reconfirmed and retains their previous opinions
Repeated calendar displays, changed system time and read RPCs neither write nor invalidate approvals
Read-only users load calendar but cannot save it; strangers and anonymous callers cannot access the project
Calendar validators and catalog remain unavailable as directly executable public functions
